title: Marvel’s Spider-Man: Miles Morales
tagline: Miles takes the mask for a winter in Harlem.
releaseLabel: PlayStation 4 and PlayStation 5: November 12, 2020. A Windows version followed in 2022.
summary: Miles Morales covers Peter’s city during a winter story of his own. The Rhino appears. The central conflict is with Phin Mason, a Harlem inventor. She is not the comic-book Tinkerer, Phineas Mason, so this record does not file her under that villain.
gameplay: The same open-world swinging as the 2018 game, with Miles’s venom blast and camouflage added to the combat.
